description.str:
A palm-sized, dense block of brass, copper, smokeless powder, RDX, or similar materials.

This could be used to manufacture <color_green>ammunition</color> at the Oroboros.

A small, dense block of brass, copper, smokeless powder, RDX, or similar materials.

This could be used to manufacture <color_green>ammunition</color> at the Oroboros.

A palm-sized, dense block of steel, aluminum, various alloys, or similar materials.

This could be used to manufacture <color_green>weapons and tools</color> at the Oroboros.

A palm-sized, very dense block of titanium, high-grade steel, or similar advanced materials.

This could be used to manufacture <color_green>potent weapons and specialized equipment</color> at the Oroboros.
